Introduction
This document outlines the 
equipment maintenance inspection on the 6 kv CB and 380v CB which must be performed every 1500 hours of 
operation. This procedure was applied in ABU QIR power plant since 1985 and the 
finial draft is issued in August 2004
The first draft initiated by eng. Mohamed Hassan Toto, 
accepted by eng. Khalil Aly Khalil general director of Abu Kir PS, 
approved by eng. Ahmed Taha 
Hashim Head Sector of Abu Kir PS, 
and certified 
by eng. Mona Ahmad El Sharkawy: WDEPC Inspection and Quality Control head 
sector.

 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
